image_style: gray reverse-blur paired H&E and FICTURE crops
prompt_legend_rule: Generate RGB, Major Compartment, and cell type lines from ficture_factor_prompt_legend_from_html.csv, which is extracted directly from source_matched_factor_info_with_llm_inferred_celltypes.html. Do not hand-write or rewrite factor meanings.
model_visibility_rule: The model receives only paired crop images and prompt text. GOOD/MID/BAD and Dice/Precision/Recall are evaluation-only fields.

tests.name: Test1 Cross-label tissue classification
tests.output: six tissue-class scores per candidate; predicted class is the highest score

tests.name: Test2 Same-class candidate mask retrieval
tests.output: rank candidates within each true tissue class by that class score
